funFact: Mount Everest grows about half a centimeter taller every single year!
story: A tiny explorer climbed to the top of a great mountain and discovered the mountain's secret: it stays strong by standing perfectly still and breathing with the wind.
description: Stand up big and tall like a giant mountain! ⛰️ Press your feet into the floor, squeeze your legs strong, and let your arms hang by your sides. Take a slow dragon breath in... and out. You are unshakeable!

funFact: A starfish can regrow a whole new arm if it loses one!
story: High above the sea, a little star wished it could shine in the water too. So it turned into a starfish and sparkled on the ocean floor for all the fish to see.
description: Jump your feet wide and stretch your arms out like a shining star! ⭐ Spread your fingers into sparkly points. Now smile as bright as you can — TWINKLE, TWINKLE!

funFact: Trees really do talk to each other — they send messages through their roots!
story: Deep in a magical forest, one little tree learned to stand super still so the birds would build their nests in its branches.
description: Stand tall like a mighty tree! 🌳 Press one foot onto your other leg — ankle or thigh, never the knee. Grow your branches (arms!) way up high. Wobbling is part of the fun — trees sway in the wind too!

funFact: Palm trees bend in hurricanes instead of breaking — bending makes them strong!
story: On a sunny island beach, a palm tree danced with the ocean breeze all day, swishing left and right while the waves clapped along.
description: Stand tall and reach both arms way up like palm leaves! 🌴 Now sway gently side to side — swiiish, swiiish. Keep your feet glued to the sand and let the breeze move your branches!

funFact: Utkatasana actually means 'fierce pose' — sitting on invisible chairs is fierce work!
story: A friendly wizard turned all the chairs in the castle invisible. Now everyone in the kingdom sits on magic invisible chairs — and their legs got super strong!
description: Ready for magic? Pretend there's an invisible chair behind you! 🪑 Bend your knees and sit back sloooowly, keeping your knees behind your toes. Reach your arms up high. Can you feel your leg muscles buzzing?

funFact: This powerful stance is also called Victory Squat — champions have used it for thousands of years!
story: The Goddess of Thunder stood on her mountain, knees bent and arms raised, and every time she flexed her muscles, tiny sparks of lightning danced from her fingers.
description: Step your feet wide and point your toes out like a duck! Bend your knees and sink down low. 👑 Now lift your arms into strong cactus shapes and flex those muscles — you are POWERFUL!

funFact: The warrior poses are named after Virabhadra, a hero from an ancient Indian story.
story: A brave young warrior climbed to the castle gates, planted their feet, and raised their arms to the sky, shouting, 'I am brave enough for any adventure!'
description: Step one foot way back and point your front toes forward! Bend your front knee like a hero landing. 🗡️ Now sweep both arms up to the sky and stand proud. Say it with me: 'I am BRAVE!'

funFact: Holding warrior poses makes some of the biggest muscles in your whole body stronger.
story: The warrior stood on a high cliff, stretched out both arms, and gazed past their fingertips toward the far horizon where the next adventure was waiting.
description: Step your feet wide apart and turn your front toes forward! Bend that front knee — strong like a hero. 🏹 Stretch your arms out like airplane wings and look past your front fingers. What adventure do you see?

benefits: Stretches the back of the legs
funFact: Hanging upside down sends fresh blood to your brain — that's why folding forward can feel so calming.
story: A curious kid discovered that if you fold forward and peek between your legs, the whole world flips upside down — houses hang from the sky and clouds become the floor!
description: Stand tall, breathe in... and fold forward like a floppy waterfall! 🙇 Let your arms and head dangle down. Bend your knees as much as you like. Now peek between your legs — hello, upside-down world!

benefits: Helps you feel loose and calm
funFact: Letting your head hang heavy helps the muscles in your neck take a mini vacation.
story: A little ragdoll flopped over the edge of the toy box, arms swinging gently, humming a sleepy song while it waited for playtime.
description: Fold forward with soft, bendy knees and hold your elbows like a cozy basket. 🧸 Let your head hang heavy and sway gently side to side. Flop, flop, floooop — you're the world's most relaxed ragdoll!

funFact: This pose is named after the young monkey hero Hanuman, who loved to leap toward the sun.
story: Every morning, a little monkey knelt on the mountaintop and reached both arms up to greet the rising sun with a giant stretch.
description: Step one foot forward and lower your back knee gently to the ground. 🌅 Now sweep your arms up like you're saying good morning to the sun! Feel the big cozy stretch in your legs. Ahhh!

funFact: In this pose your body makes a triangle — one of the strongest shapes in the world!
story: Two campers turned themselves into tents on a starry night, and a family of hedgehogs happily trotted underneath them to get home.
description: Step your feet super wide and fold forward slowly — you're a tent! ⛺ Put your hands on the floor and let your head dangle. Now peek through your legs... can you spot a friend back there?

benefits: Opens the ribs for big breaths
funFact: Your ribs can spread apart like an accordion when you take a really big breath.
story: The kingdom's gate loved its job: every morning it swung open with a happy creeeeak to let the sunshine and all the friendly animals come inside.
description: Kneel on one knee and stretch your other leg out to the side like a gate! 🚪 Now reach your arm up and over your head — creeeeak, the gate is opening! Take a big breath into your stretchy side.

funFact: Surfers squat low on their boards because bent knees are the secret to great balance.
story: A brave little surfer paddled out past the splashy waves, hopped up on the board, and rode the biggest, sparkliest wave all the way back to shore!
description: Hop onto your surfboard — feet wide, knees bent! 🏄 Stretch your arms out to steer. Whoa, here comes a big wave... bend lower and riiiide it! Cowabunga!

funFact: Ski racers crouch into a tuck shape to zoom faster than a car on the highway!
story: At the tip-top of a snowy mountain, a little skier took a deep frosty breath, tucked down low, and zoomed through the sparkly powder — swish, swish, swish!
description: Feet together, knees bent, and swing your arms back like ski poles! ⛷️ Crouch into your speedy racer tuck. Ready... set... ZOOM down the mountain! Swish left, swish right!

funFact: Striking a strong 'power pose' can really make you feel braver — scientists have studied it!
story: The city needed a hero — and WHOOSH, down from the clouds came the bravest kid in the world, landing on one knee with a fist to the ground. The crowd cheered!
description: You're flying over the city... time to land! 🦸 Step one foot forward, lower down with your fist gently touching the floor, and look up like a hero. Now rise slowly with your cape flowing. The city is safe!

funFact: Flamingos can sleep while standing on just one leg!
story: In a pink lagoon, a young flamingo practiced standing on one leg every day, until one day it balanced so long that a butterfly landed right on its beak.
description: Stand tall and lift one knee up in front of you like a fancy flamingo! 🦩 Hold your leg or stretch your arms out like wings. Can you balance while you count to five? Wobbles just mean you're flapping!

funFact: In this pose your body makes a capital letter T — you become a flying letter!
story: The warrior learned the greatest lesson of all: to fly like an arrow, you must be calm, steady, and pointed straight at your dream.
description: Stand on one leg and slowly tip forward like a seesaw! 🦅 Stretch your other leg back and your arms forward until your body is flat like a table. You're flying! Keep your eyes on one spot to stay steady.

funFact: Even the strongest warriors bow — bowing is how they show kindness and respect.
story: After winning the great race, the warrior bowed low to thank the mountain, the wind, and every friend who cheered along the way.
description: Start in Warrior I, then clasp your hands behind your back like a secret handshake! 🙏 Now bow forward slowly inside your front leg, lifting your arms behind you. Strong AND gentle — that's a true hero!

benefits: Opens the chest for big breaths
funFact: This pose is sometimes called Rainbow Warrior because your top arm arcs like a rainbow.
story: After the storm passed, the warrior leaned back, reached one arm to the sky, and painted a giant rainbow from one side of the valley to the other.
description: From Warrior II, flip your front hand up and reach for the sky! 🌈 Let your back hand rest gently on your back leg and lean back like you're painting a rainbow. Keep that front knee bent and strong!

funFact: Ashta Chandrasana means 'crescent moon pose' — your body curves just like the moon's smile.
story: One night the crescent moon slid down from the sky to play, and everyone who saw it stretched up tall and curved their bodies to say hello.
description: Step one foot back and stay high on your back tippy-toes! 🌙 Bend your front knee, then sweep your arms up and curve gently back like a crescent moon. Shine bright, moon-kid!

benefits: Gets you ready to run and play
funFact: The Sanskrit name means 'horse riding pose' — it looks like a rider ready to gallop!
story: A swift pony crouched at the starting line of the great meadow race, muscles ready, waiting for the whistle... and they're off!
description: Step one foot way back like a runner at the starting line! 🐎 Bend your front knee, keep your back leg long and strong, and press your fingertips to the floor. On your mark... get set... hold steady!

funFact: Triangles are so strong that builders use them in bridges and towers all over the world.
story: The shapes had a contest to see who was strongest, and the triangle won! Now kids everywhere turn into triangles to feel strong too.
description: Step your feet wide and stretch your arms out! 🔺 Tip sideways over your front leg and slide that hand down your shin. Reach your other arm up to the sky and look at your fingers. You're the strongest shape!

funFact: In this pose you make one long line from your foot to your fingertips — like a ray of sunshine.
story: A little sunbeam wanted to reach the farthest flower in the garden, so it stretched loooonger and looonger until it tickled the flower's petals.
description: From Warrior II, lean over your bent knee and rest your elbow on it! 📐 Now stretch your top arm past your ear, making one loooong line. Reach like you're touching the farthest star!

benefits: Stretches the back of the legs
funFact: The pyramids of Egypt have stood strong for more than 4,000 years!
story: In the golden desert, a wise pyramid whispered its secret to travelers: 'Stand steady, breathe slowly, and you can last forever.'
description: Step one foot back with both feet flat, legs straight like pyramid walls! 🔻 Put your hands on your hips, breathe in tall... then fold slowly over your front leg. You're an ancient wonder!

funFact: Eagles can spot a rabbit from three kilometers up in the sky!
story: A golden eagle perched on the tallest pine, wrapped its wings in tight, and watched the whole valley with its super-hero eyes before soaring away.
description: Wrap one leg over the other and twist your arms together like a pretzel! 🦅 Sit back a little, lift your elbows, and stare at one spot with your eagle eyes. Squeeze everything tight — you've got this!

benefits: Stretches the front of the body
funFact: This pose is named after Nataraja, the lord of the dance in ancient Indian stories.
story: When the music box opened, the little dancer inside rose on one leg, reached for the sky, and spun a dance so lovely the stars leaned in to watch.
description: Stand on one leg and catch your other foot behind you! 💃 Reach your free arm forward like you're offering a gift, then gently press your foot back and up. You're a beautiful dancing statue!

benefits: Gives the spine a gentle twist
funFact: Gentle twists are like wringing out a sponge — they help your body feel fresh and new.
story: The wizard's invisible chair had one more trick: if you sat on it and twisted like a corkscrew, it would spin you off to a brand-new adventure!
description: Sit back on your invisible chair, then press your hands together at your heart. 🌀 Twist your chest to one side and hook your elbow outside your knee. Keep breathing... twisty magic activated!

funFact: Airplane wings angle back just like your arms do in this pose — it helps with smooth flying!
story: Flight 123 to Dreamland is ready for takeoff! The little plane rolled down the runway, tipped forward, and lifted off into the cotton-candy clouds.
description: Stand on one leg and tip forward slowly, stretching your other leg behind you. ✈️ Sweep your arms back like airplane wings. Engines on — vrrrmmmm! Look at one spot ahead and enjoy the flight!

benefits: Opens the ribs for deep breaths
funFact: Your side body has muscles between every rib that stretch like tiny rubber bands when you lean.
story: The moon felt a bit stiff after sitting in the sky all night, so it leaned waaay over to one side for a big stretchy yawn — and all the stars giggled.
description: Stand tall and press your palms together way up high! 🌜 Now lean slowly to one side, making a banana-moon curve with your whole body. Breathe into your stretchy side, then curve the other way!

benefits: Stretches the back of the legs
funFact: Some birds dip their beaks in water and tip their heads back to swallow — gulp, gulp!
story: By the sparkling pond, a thirsty little bird bowed down for a sip, tipped back up to look around, then bowed for another sip — bob, bob, bob!
description: Stand on one leg with your other leg stretched behind you. 🐦 Tip forward slowly to take a pretend sip of water — glug! — then rise back up tall. Bob down and up three times like a happy drinking bird!

funFact: Windmills twist in the breeze to turn wind into power — and you can too!
story: The old windmill on the hill loved windy days best, when it could spin its long arms and grind flour for the whole village's pancakes.
description: Step your feet wide and fold forward with one hand on the floor under your nose. 🌪️ Now twist and reach your other arm up to the sky! Look up at your hand. Switch sides — you're a spinning windmill!

benefits: Stretches the back of the legs
funFact: Your big toe does the most work of all your toes when you balance and walk.
story: One day the fingers and toes finally met! The fingers folded all the way down, grabbed the big toes, and they've been best friends ever since.
description: Stand with feet apart and fold forward slowly. 🦶 Reach down and grab your big toes with your peace-sign fingers! Bend your knees if you need to. Breathe out and let your head hang — hello, toes!

funFact: Gorillas walk on their knuckles, so their wrists get a nice stretch every day!
story: A gentle gorilla found the perfect way to rest after a day of jungle games: standing up, folding over, and tucking its hands under its own big feet like slippers.
description: Fold forward like a friendly gorilla! 🦍 Slide your hands under your feet, palms up, so your toes tickle your wrists. Bend your knees as much as you like and hang there. Ooh-ooh-ah-ah!

funFact: Circus acrobats train for years to kick their legs high — every bit of stretch counts!
story: At the circus, the youngest acrobat amazed the crowd by folding forward and lifting one leg so high it nearly touched the sparkly tent roof.
description: Fold forward and put your hands on the floor. 🎪 Now sloooowly lift one leg up behind you as high as it happily goes! Keep your standing knee soft. It doesn't need to be high — every leg-lift is circus-worthy!
safetyNote: Keep both hands on the floor or a block, and lift the leg only as high as feels easy.

funFact: The moon doesn't make its own light — it shines by reflecting sunlight like a giant mirror.
story: Half of the moon went missing one night, so a brave kid balanced on one leg, stretched out wide, and became the missing half so the sky would be bright again.
description: Put one hand on the floor (or a block) and lift your back leg up to the side! 🌗 Open your chest and reach your top arm to the sky. You're shining sideways like the half moon! Wobbles are just moonbeams.
safetyNote: Practice next to a wall and use a block under your hand for support.

benefits: Stretches the front of the leg
funFact: Real sugarcane is a giant grass that can grow taller than a basketball hoop!
story: In a candy-sweet field, one sugarcane curled itself into a beautiful bow shape, and the wind played it like a harp all afternoon.
description: From Half Moon, bend your top leg and reach back to catch your foot! 🍭 Gently press your foot into your hand to make a sweet candy-cane curve. Keep looking at the floor to stay steady. So sweet!
safetyNote: Only try after Half Moon feels easy. Use a wall behind you and a block under your hand.

funFact: The moon slowly spins as it circles Earth — it twirls just like you in this pose.
story: The half moon got curious about what was behind it, so it balanced carefully and twisted around to peek — and discovered a sky full of brand-new stars.
description: Balance like Warrior III with one hand on the floor under your shoulder. 🌘 Now twist your chest and reach your other arm to the sky! Keep your lifted leg strong like a moonbeam. Breathe and shine!
safetyNote: Use a block under your hand and keep a wall nearby for balance.

funFact: Twisting poses give your spine a gentle wake-up, like turning a key in a music box.
story: The triangle wanted to see the other side of the meadow, so it carefully spun itself around without moving its feet — what a clever shape!
description: Step one foot back with both feet flat. 🔄 Reach your opposite hand down to your front shin or a block, then twist and lift your other arm to the sky! Keep both legs strong and steady. Twisty triangle power!
safetyNote: Use a block under your bottom hand and twist only as far as feels comfy.

funFact: Your spine is made of 33 bones stacked like building blocks that let you twist and bend.
story: Deep in the jungle, an explorer crouched in a lunge and twisted around to spot the hidden waterfall behind the vines — treasure found!
description: Take a strong lunge, then press your hands together at your heart. 🔀 Twist your chest and hook your elbow outside your front knee. Push your palms together and breathe big jungle-explorer breaths!
safetyNote: Drop your back knee to the floor if the balance feels wobbly. Twist gently.

funFact: In 'bound' poses your own hands clasp together to wrap you up like a gift bow.
story: The present under the rainbow tree tied its own ribbon! It reached one arm under, one arm over, and clasped its hands into a perfect bow.
description: From Side Angle, sneak your bottom arm under your bent leg and your top arm behind your back. 🎀 Can your hands find each other and hold on? You just tied yourself into a beautiful bow!
safetyNote: Use a strap between your hands if they don't reach — never yank your shoulders.

funFact: Standing on one bent leg makes tiny balance muscles in your ankle work like busy ants.
story: The invisible chair shrunk until only one leg could fit! The clever kid crossed the other ankle on top like a number 4 and balanced anyway.
description: Sit back on your invisible chair, then cross one ankle over your other knee — you made a number 4! 🪑 Press your hands together at your heart and sit back slowly. Steady... steady... you're doing it!
safetyNote: Hold a wall or chair back with one hand until your balance feels solid.

funFact: Lotus flowers sleep at night — they close their petals and open again at sunrise.
story: A magical tree grew a lotus flower right on its trunk, and everyone came from far away to see the tree that bloomed while standing on one leg.
description: Stand tall and lift one foot up to rest on top of your other thigh, like a lotus petal. 🪷 Hold your foot there gently and press your palms together at your heart. Breathe slowly — you're a blooming tree!
safetyNote: Only place the foot on the thigh if your hips are ready — never force the knee. Keep a wall close.

funFact: Twisting while balancing uses both sides of your brain at the same time!
story: Halfway up the mountain, the young explorer lunged forward and twisted around to wave goodbye to the village below — then kept on climbing.
description: Take a big lunge with your back leg long and strong. 🌪️ Press your palms together at your heart and twist over your front leg, elbow to knee. Hold on tight to your balance and breathe like a mountain wind!
safetyNote: Lower your back knee to the floor to make the twist safer and steadier.

funFact: Ballet dancers call a similar shape an 'attitude' — it takes years of gentle practice.
story: On the grandest stage, the dancer reached both arms overhead, caught their foot like a swan's wing, and the whole theater held its breath in wonder.
description: From Dancer Pose, reach up and back with both hands to hold your lifted foot, elbows pointing to the sky. 🩰 Press your foot up gently and lift your heart. You're the star of the show!
safetyNote: Advanced pose — only with a grown-up spotter, after lots of Dancer practice. Use a strap around the foot.

funFact: The bird of paradise is both a real rainforest bird AND a flower that looks like a bird taking off!
story: In the rainforest, the bird of paradise unfolded one shimmering leg-feather to the sky, stood perfectly still, and glowed like a living flower.
description: Start in Bound Side Angle, then step your feet together and slowly stand up tall, lifting your bound leg with you. 🦜 Straighten the leg as much as it likes. You're a rare, magnificent bird — ta-da!
safetyNote: Advanced pose — only with a grown-up spotter. Keep the lifted knee bent and skip it if hips or shoulders complain.

funFact: Tightrope walkers stare at one still point to balance — yogis call that spot a 'drishti'.
story: The tightrope walker paused mid-rope, lifted one leg straight out, and held their toe while the crowd below whispered, 'How do they DO that?'
description: Stand tall, lift one knee, and grab your big toe with two fingers! 🤸 Slowly stretch that leg out in front of you. Stand proud, find one spot to stare at, and breathe. Bent knees count — you're amazing!
safetyNote: Advanced pose — hold a wall with your free hand, and keep the lifted knee bent until you're steady.

funFact: In this pose your body folds like a jackknife — one of the trickiest balances in yoga!
story: The young archer needed perfect focus, so their teacher taught them a secret: balance on one leg, hold your foot, bow to your knee, and your mind becomes as still as the target.
description: Stand strong, lift one knee, and hold your foot with both hands laced around it. 🎯 Little by little, stretch that leg forward... then bow your head gently toward your knee. Super-focus mode: ON!
safetyNote: Advanced pose — only with a grown-up nearby. Keep the standing knee soft and skip the head-bow if your back complains.
